name: Superpowers
tagline: A complete software development methodology for coding agents — spec, plan, TDD, subagents, review, and merge.
description: A composable skills system that transforms any coding agent into a disciplined engineer. Before writing code, it extracts a real spec, builds a bite-sized implementation plan, enforces RED-GREEN-REFACTOR TDD, dispatches subagents per task with two-stage code review, and handles branch merging. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and more.
author: obra
suitable_for: Coding agents that jump into code without a plan
Teams wanting enforced TDD and code review
